R2 = 2*c*(2*rho + 2*(rho**2 + 1)*atan(rho) - pi*(rho**2 + 1))/(pi*(rho**2 + 1))
grad2 (Dr)^2 = rho*(-2*beta*c*rho**3*atan(rho) + pi*beta*c*rho**3 - 2*beta*c*rho**2 - 2*beta*c*rho*atan(rho) + pi*beta*c*rho - 2*beta*c - 2*c*rho**3*exp(2*c*v/pi)*atan(rho) + pi*c*rho**3*exp(2*c*v/pi) - 2*c*rho**2*exp(2*c*v/pi) - 2*c*rho*exp(2*c*v/pi)*atan(rho) + pi*c*rho*exp(2*c*v/pi) + pi*rho*exp(2*c*v/pi))*exp(-2*c*v/pi)/(pi*(rho**2 + 1))
mMS = sqrt((beta + exp(2*c*v/pi))*exp(-2*c*v/pi))*(beta*c*rho**4*atan(rho) - pi*beta*c*rho**4/2 + beta*c*rho**3 + beta*c*rho**2*atan(rho) - pi*beta*c*rho**2/2 + beta*c*rho + c*rho**4*exp(2*c*v/pi)*atan(rho) - pi*c*rho**4*exp(2*c*v/pi)/2 + c*rho**3*exp(2*c*v/pi) + c*rho**2*exp(2*c*v/pi)*atan(rho) - pi*c*rho**2*exp(2*c*v/pi)/2 + pi*exp(2*c*v/pi)/2)*exp(-2*c*v/pi)/(pi*sqrt(rho**2 + 1))
